findings.message: The deleted `--- Plan contract resolver ---` block also removed `test_lint_reports_file_line_numbers`. That test checks that `lint_spec` reports the correct file line for a `data_outside_block` finding. `lint_spec` is not one of the deleted functions, and nothing else in tests/test_specs.py checks `finding.line`, so the change silently drops coverage of behaviour the ticket keeps. The Definition of rejected forbids changes to anything outside the plan machinery.
findings.paved_road: Restore `test_lint_reports_file_line_numbers` unchanged in tests/test_specs.py, for example right after `test_validate_data_blocks_flags_unpaired_delimiter`. Delete only the tests that call the removed plan functions.
